notes: Two isnads before one saying: «حدثني أبي» and «وحدثني محمد بن جعفر» are separate groups; the saying follows the second.
«بعض أصحابه» is an unnamed gap at both places; kept in place, not filled.
«أبي عبد الله (ع)» is written inside the chain after «عن»: narrator, not imam_in_text (owner ruling 2).
